title: What Kind of Paradise
description: A teenage girl breaks free from her father’s world of isolation to discover that her whole life is a lie in this propulsive new novel from the New York Times bestselling author of Pretty Things and Watch Me Disappear.A twisty, sharp coming-of-age story for our strange techno-utopian times. - Rachel Khong, author of Real AmericansThe first thing you have to understand is that my father was my entire world.Growing u...
